title: Accounts, Scheduling, Logging & Recovery
purpose: Extend earlier administration with account consistency, exact scheduler ownership, loaded job results, journal evidence, private rotation, local notices and recovery access. Sequence is guidance, not an unlock.
prerequisites: Earlier users/groups, cron/timers, logs, quoting/statuses and separate-destination backup. Existing administrator guest only; no credential, login-policy or package changes.
coverage: LPIC-1 active v5.0:partial107.1/107.2/108.2;101.3 wall-tool preparation;104.5 reinforcement. LPIC-2 active v4.5.0:206.2 reinforcement only. Self-reviewed and unscored; no full objectives or exam-readiness claim.
